laws.rule: Since 1 July 2019, Tennessee's hands-free law (T.C.A. 55-8-199) makes it illegal for a driver to hold a phone or other mobile device with any part of the body. Drivers may not touch the phone to use GPS navigation. Breaking the rule can add points to the driving record.
laws.penalty_signal: A Class C misdemeanour, described by the General Assembly's Fiscal Review Committee in 2020 as a fine of up to US$50, rising to US$100 for a third offence or a crash, and US$200 in a work zone with workers present or a school zone with flashers on (about A$71, A$142 and A$284 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040).

items.text: Since 1 January 2026, hemp-derived cannabinoid products (THC products made from hemp, including THCA products) are regulated by the Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission under Public Chapter 526 (2025). Products may hold no more than 0.3% total THC, counting THCA (the raw form that becomes THC when heated) as well as delta-9 THC; THCP and synthetic cannabinoids are banned in any amount. Sales must be in person at a licensed shop, with no delivery or shipping to consumers.

Kratom (a leaf product from a Southeast Asian tree) may be sold in Tennessee only in its natural form and only to adults 21 and over; selling it in another form, selling it to anyone under 21, or buying or possessing it under 21 is a Class A misdemeanour (T.C.A. 39-17-452). Bills to make kratom possession a crime were before the 2025 to 2026 General Assembly.

layers.authority: US National Park Service, Great Smoky Mountains National Park
layers.process: The park lies in both Tennessee and North Carolina. A parking tag is required for any vehicle parked longer than 15 minutes. Daily US$5, weekly US$15, annual US$40 (about A$7, A$21, A$57). The tag must be physical, show the vehicle's plate, and isn't specific to a location; a tag does not guarantee a space; America the Beautiful passes don't replace it. Daily and weekly tags are sold on recreation.gov (up to six months ahead; print it), at visitor centres, retailers and 24-hour machines. Disability placards or plates, approved school groups and permitted researchers are exempt, and there are listed free days in 2026 (16 Feb, 25 May, 14 Jun, 3 to 5 Jul, 25 Aug, 17 Sep, 27 Oct, 11 Nov). Fees in US dollars; A$1 = USD 0.7040 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026), so US$1 is about A$1.42.
